item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa kun 'dus 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las tsakra gser gyi bum bzang
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rad+na gling pas/ chu sprel zla tshes bzang por dbal bon ru lag shel ri phyug mo nas spyan drangs te slar las ldan bla grwa mang pos bskul ma gnang bzhin chu bya sa ga zla ba'i tshes bzang por shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba'i drung yig tshul khrims blo ldan gyis bris shing yi ge dang po'i byed po 'gru bon drung mu nas bgyis pas 'chi med rgyal ba'i phrin las rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
